# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Follow the root `AGENTS.md` for owner approvals, safety, scope, plain-English reports and verification. This short pointer does not replace or override that policy.

When the owner says `Start`, consult `START_HERE.md`: first understand their idea or perform a bounded read-only audit of an existing project. Do not begin implementation or publication without the relevant approval.

Inspect real build/test commands before adapting `verification.json`; the checked-in example only verifies the starter kit. Prefer focused checks, protect unrelated work, and never claim unrun checks passed.
